messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — PR #3124 is blocked by a proto lint failure in CI. It flags a field naming rule; the root cause is we have a proto field `user_id` that the linter says should be lowerCamelCase. I don't want to change the wire/stored field if that would break downstreams. @jason @kevin can one of you weigh in before I push a fix? CI excerpt: `FIELD_NAMES_LOWER_CAMEL: proto/user.proto:12: field name 'user_id' is not lowerCamelCase`

jason: I wouldn't change the actual field numbers/names if it affects storage. Can we keep the proto field as-is and set `json_name` so generated JSON for JS becomes `userId`? That keeps wire compatibility but satisfies JS consumers.

kevin: FWIW we usually keep proto field identifiers snake_case to match older codegen, but using `json_name` is the common workaround. Do we know when buf/our lint rules started enforcing lowerCamelCase? Might be a new rule in the staged lint config.

maria: Good point. I checked, the rule landed in the shared buf lint repo last week (`FIELD_NAMES_LOWER_CAMEL`). Changing the actual proto identifier would be breaking. Proposed minimal fix: add `json_name = "userId"` to the field and add a small note in the changelog + SDK mapping test update. Example diff I'm planning to push:
```proto
message User {
  // Keep proto field for storage compatibility
  int64 user_id = 1 [json_name = "userId"];
}
```

jason: That looks fine to me. Also please run `buf format -w ./proto` and `buf lint ./proto` locally before pushing so CI is less noisy.

maria: Yep I'll run both. Also will add a short comment above the field explaining the reason for `json_name` so future readers don't flip it back.

ryan: If you add `json_name`, remember to update the OpenAPI generator config we use for the docs/SDKs — otherwise the docs will still show `user_id` and confuse consumers.

maria: Good call — I'll update `openapi/config.yaml` in the same PR and add a test to the JS SDK mapping that expects `userId` in JSON. Will link the generator PR in the description.

maria: Pushing the fix now, will include changelog note under `docs/changes/patch-3124.md`. @jason if you can eyeball the comment and generator config change after CI passes that'd be great.

ci-bot: Buf format and lint ran on branch maria/proto-json. Lint: PASS.

ci-bot: Build #902 — tests passed :white_check_mark: (go: unit, js: mapping)

jason: :thumbsup: LGTM, thanks for keeping it non-breaking.

maria: Thanks all — pushed and merged after CI. Added a short migration note for SDK teams. Closing PR. :tada:
